file_stem: RWB E1 027 Decision log writer v1
title: Decision log writer v1
goal: One writer records every Epic 1 decision with its rule ID and version, inside the action's transaction
why: 'No record, no action.' Every module calls one writer so each decision carries who, what rule, which version and which inputs.
ace_note: No ACE read. Callers pass an inputs_ref that points at what they read (for example ACE freshness stamps).
stores: Outbox (EV-08 for ledger and reporting); metric decision_log_repeats_total; incident on failure
rules: BR2: decision code, inputs ref, final call, decided at and actor are required
BR3: at least one of rule, model or agent version; a rule ID needs its rule version
BR7: decision codes are parameters rwb.decision.code.*
risks: Missing version group, inputs ref or case -> refused (MSG-P7-009)
Store unwritable -> caller rolls back + incident (MSG-P7-003)
example: JOB-02 creates RW-2026-000123 -> entry CASE_CREATED, actor SY-CASEWF
JOB-03 assigns owner U-7101 by row ALLOC-MTG-BKK-01 of ALLOC-2026.11 -> entry OWNER_ASSIGNED
2 entries, 2 DecisionRecorded events in the outbox
